title: Affine singleton tensor-section Cech complex as Amitsur
statement: Let X be a scheme and F a quasi-coherent X-module. Let U,W be etale X-schemes whose underlying schemes are affine and let g:W→U. Put A=Γ(U.left,top), B=Γ(W.left,top) with algebra structure given by g.appTop, and M=Γ(U.hom tensor-pullback F,top). The Mathlib Cech complex for the singleton g of the restricted ULift tensor-section sheaf is isomorphic to the Amitsur complex A,B,M after forgetting scalars and applying ULift. Flatness and surjectivity are not assumed. [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] [lem-pc-cech-exact]

source.place: Tag 03P2, affine-case proof, paragraph identifying the singleton Cech complex with (B/A) tensor M before exactness; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03P2

proof.text: Obtain normalized degree isomorphisms from exists_singletonTensorDegreeComparison. This performs the affine fibre-product and pullback-section step without yet claiming coface compatibility.
Apply singletonTensorDegreeComparison_coface. Its proved double tensor induction extends the pure-tensor coface equation to every element.

For adjacent degrees, unfold the two alternating coface differentials. The forget-and-ULift functor preserves sums and integer multiples; composition distributes over these sums. Sum the coface equations with signs (-1)^j. Build the Amitsur-to-Cech complex isomorphism with HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents and invert it. For nonadjacent degrees the complex constructor supplies zero differentials.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_etale_affine_singleton_tensor_amitsur_iso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤) := g.left.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    Nonempty (((cechComplexFunctor fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Over.mk g).obj
      ((Over.forget U).op ⋙
        ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
          (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F)).obj)) ≅
      (((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(U.left, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⋙
        AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.amitsurComplex Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤)
            Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤)))
